resources.string: Hands need a model that sees the screen: Bailian, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or any provider with vision models.
Tap “%1$s”: confirm in Momoding (it asks for your screen lock).

Some apps cannot be reached directly, so it uses the phone the way you do: a look at the screen, then a tap, some typing, a swipe. What the phone itself and its own computer can do comes first; borrowing your screen comes last. Off by default.
Each step sends this model the list of what is on the screen (buttons, fields, text), and a screenshot when the list is not enough. It is a setting apart from the chat model.
Turn on Momoding under Installed apps in the accessibility settings
This phone is older; screenshots are not available to the service.
Add a provider with a vision model, such as qwen-vl or gpt-4o
Allow it, so the capsule with Stop can be shown
While it works, the accessibility service reads what is on the screen (buttons, fields, text) and taps for it; only during a task you gave it. Drawing over other apps is for the capsule.
This screen is protected and cannot be read. Finish this part yourself, then tap Continue.
It asks before paying, sending, posting or deleting.
Your screen comes last: the phone itself and its own computer first.
Each step\'s screenshot is kept with the conversation and sent only to your own model.
Never types passwords, codes or card numbers; it hands the phone to you.
Stop is always on the screen; nothing continues after it.
A password or code field: please fill it in yourself, then tap Continue.
On, but something below is still missing
Off; the agent will say so when a task needs the screen
Let the agent use the screen
While it works, a capsule at the top of the screen shows each step and a Stop button. Logins, passwords and codes are always left to you.
The only model that can see pictures
first in your default group that can see
Do this part yourself, then tap Continue.
No model you have set up can see pictures. Add one that does (for example qwen3.8-27b on Alibaba Cloud Bailian) to let Momoding operate the screen.
On: it works on a hidden screen of its own; you keep using your phone
Off: it works on your screen, as before
Tap to let Momoding use Shizuku
Shizuku is installed but not running: tap to open it and start it
Needs the free Shizuku app: tap to install it

With Shizuku, Momoding opens apps on a screen you don\'t see and works there, so your screen stays yours. Logins and anything it shouldn\'t do alone still come to you. Without Shizuku it works on your screen.
